title: R Interface to libcmaes
text: lightweight R interface libcmaes C++ library covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES). allows optimization black-box functions using CMA-ES algorithm variants. patched copy libcmaes bundled package, system dependencies needed beyond standard C++ toolchain (Eigen headers provided RcppEigen package build time).

title: R Interface to libcmaes
text: basic example shows solve common test problem, sphere function. objective function receives numeric vector returns single number. cmaes_control() collects settings algorithm, cmaes() runs optimization.
code: library(libcmaesr)  fn = function(x) sum(x^2)  dim = 3 x0 = rep(0.5, dim) lower = rep(-1, dim) upper = rep(1, dim)  control = cmaes_control(algo = "bipop", max_fevals = 5000 * dim, seed = 123, lambda = 5) res = cmaes(fn, x0, lower, upper, control)  res$x #> [1] -1.102e-09 -4.948e-10  1.933e-09 res$y #> [1] 5.195e-18 res$status_msg #> [1] "[Success] The optimization has converged"

title: R Interface to libcmaes
text: Set batch = TRUE evaluate whole generation . objective function receives matrix lambda rows one column per dimension, returns one objective value per row. useful evaluation can vectorized parallelized.
code: fn_batch = function(x) rowSums(x^2)  control = cmaes_control(algo = "acmaes", max_fevals = 1000, seed = 123, lambda = 10) res = cmaes(fn_batch, x0, lower, upper, control, batch = TRUE)  res$y #> [1] 2.185e-16

title: Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy — cmaes
text: objective (function(x)) Objective function, minimize. batch FALSE, x numeric vector length n function must return scalar numeric. batch TRUE, x numeric matrix one row per candidate n columns. number rows can vary iterations, e.g., restart strategies like IPOP BIPOP increase population size time, assume always lambda. function must return numeric vector one element per row x. latter usually reduces overhead allows orchestrate parallelization need objective function expensive. x0 (numeric(n)) Initial point. NB: point IGNORED also set x0_lower x0_upper control object, must still vector length n! lower (numeric(n)) Lower bounds search space. upper (numeric(n)) Upper bounds search space. control (cmaes_control) control object created cmaes_control(). Default control object parameters set default values. batch (logical(1)) Whether objective function evaluates batch points . Default FALSE.

title: Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy — cmaes
text: (named list). List elements: 'x': (numeric(n)) best point found, length corresponds x0, lower upper. 'y': (numeric(1)) objective value best point. 'edm': (numeric(1)) Expected distance minimum. 'time': (numeric(1)) time taken find solution seconds. 'status_code': (integer(1)) status code, indicating success, failure, reason stopping. See : https://github.com/CMA-ES/libcmaes/wiki/Optimizing--function 'status_msg': (character(1)) human-readable status message libcmaes.

title: CMA-ES Control Object — cmaes_control
text: maximize (logical(1)) Whether maximize objective function. Default FALSE. algo (character(1)) CMAES variant use. Possible values : cmaes_algos. Default "acmaes", recommended https://github.com/CMA-ES/libcmaes/wiki/Practical-hints. multimodal problems, likely want use "ipop" "bipop". max_fevals (integer(1)) maximum number function evaluations. NA disable. Default 100. max_iter (integer(1)) maximum number ES iterations. NA disable (default). ftarget (numeric(1)) Stop target function value reached. NA disable (default). f_tolerance (numeric(1)) Sets function tolerance stopping criterion; monitors (absolute) difference function value iterations stops optimization tolerance. NA disable (default). x_tolerance (numeric(1)) Sets parameter (absolute) tolerance stopping criterion. checks entries covariance matrix, touch know . NA disable (default). lambda (integer(1)) Number generated descendants per iteration. Must least 2; NA default handling libcmaes. sigma (numeric(1)) Initial sigma covariance. NA default handling libcmaes. max_restarts (integer(1)) maximum number restarts, IPOP BIPOP. NA default handling libcmaes. elitism (integer(1)) Sets elitism: 0 elitism 1 elitism: reinjects best-ever seen solution 2 initial elitism: reinject x0 long improved upon 3 initial elitism restart: restart best encountered solution final solution reinjects best solution population better fitness, majority NA default handling libcmaes. tpa (integer(1)) Activates / deactivates two-point adaptation step-size mechanism. 0: , 1: auto, 2: yes. NA default handling libcmaes. tpa_dsigma (numeric(1)) Sets tpa dsigma value, use care. NA default handling libcmaes. seed (integer(1)) seed random number generator. NA (default), seed generated randomly R thereby coupled RNG-state R. Otherwise, RNG libcmaes different one R hence subject R's seeding. Special value 0 used handling libcmaes, system time used libcmaes seed. quiet (logical(1)) Whether suppress libcmaes output. Internal logging libcmaes rerouted Rprintf, things like capture.output() work. Useful debugging. Default TRUE. x0_lower (numeric) Optional lower bounds randomizing initial mean x0, also restarts. Use NULL disable. non-NULL, x0_upper must also set length x0_lower. x0_upper (numeric) Optional upper bounds randomizing initial mean x0, also restarts. Use NULL disable.

title: libcmaesr: R Interface to 'libcmaes' — libcmaesr-package
text: lightweight interface 'libcmaes' C++ library Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES). CMA-ES state---art evolutionary algorithm optimization difficult non-linear, non-convex black-box functions, described Hansen Ostermeier (2001) doi:10.1162/106365601750190398 . Supports active, separable, VD (diagonal plus rank-one covariance) variants algorithm well IPOP (increasing population size) BIPOP (bi-population) restart strategies. patched copy 'libcmaes' (LGPL >= 3) bundled; see COPYRIGHTS file details.
